Ezekiel's visionary temple features the threshold prominently: the glory of YHWH moves to the threshold (Ezek 9:3; 10:4, 18), and healing waters flow from beneath it (Ezek 47:1). Zephaniah condemns those who leap over the threshold in a pagan ritual (Zeph 1:9)."
